enum.name: AD_FRAME
enum.description: What kind of vehicle this is. Picks the icon, the HUD layout, and whether altitude is a first-class field.

enum.name: AD_FEATURE
enum.description: What the vehicle supports. A bit not set is a screen ArduDeck does not show. Under-declare, then grow.

entry.name: AD_FEAT_PARAMS
entry.description: Parameter read and write, with metadata.

entry.name: AD_FEAT_GEOFENCE
entry.description: RESERVED. No protocol is defined for this yet. Do not set it.

entry.name: AD_FEAT_MANUAL_CONTROL
entry.description: RESERVED. No protocol is defined for this yet. Do not set it. When it exists it will only be declarable by a vehicle whose failsafe is driven by the same link the sticks arrive on.

entry.name: AD_FEAT_LOG_DOWNLOAD
entry.description: RESERVED. No protocol is defined for this yet. Do not set it.

entry.name: AD_FEAT_TERRAIN
entry.description: Accepts terrain-relative altitudes in a plan.

entry.name: AD_FEAT_MISSION_READ
entry.description: Can read a stored mission back out.

enum.name: AD_MODE_FLAG
enum.description: How a flight mode behaves in the picker.

entry.name: AD_MODE_LOCAL_ONLY
entry.description: Exists, but the ground station may not command it.

entry.name: AD_MODE_TERMINAL
entry.description: Reached, not chosen. A finished or failed state.

entry.name: AD_MODE_MISSION
entry.description: The mode that flies a mission. A ground station selects it before starting one. Mark exactly one.

enum.name: AD_PARAM_FLAG
enum.description: How a parameter behaves in the editor.

entry.name: AD_PARAM_REBOOT
entry.description: Read once at boot. The editor offers a reboot after writing.

entry.name: AD_PARAM_OPTIONS
entry.description: Has a list of named options, sent as ARDUDECK_PARAM_OPTION.

enum.name: AD_CAL_KIND
enum.description: The shape of a calibration, which is what decides the screen ArduDeck draws for it.

entry.name: AD_CAL_POSITIONAL
entry.description: Hold the vehicle in each named attitude until it is accepted.

entry.name: AD_CAL_COVERAGE
entry.description: Keep moving until every track reaches its target.

entry.name: AD_CAL_SWEEP
entry.description: Drive one input through its range while the vehicle records.

enum.name: AD_CAL_REQ
enum.description: What the operator must be warned about. This warns; it never authorises. The vehicle is the only gate.

entry.name: AD_CAL_REQ_STATIONARY
entry.description: Prompt to put the vehicle down first.

entry.name: AD_CAL_REQ_MOTORS_LIVE
entry.description: Motors will spin. Strongest warning, plus hold to confirm.

entry.name: AD_CAL_REQ_LOCAL_ONLY
entry.description: Listed but not startable from the ground station.

entry.name: AD_CAL_REQ_LEVEL_SURFACE
entry.description: Prompt for a surface known to be level.

entry.name: AD_CAL_ACCEPT
entry.description: The current pose is held, capture it.

entry.name: AD_CAL_CANCEL
entry.description: Abandon. Must always be honoured, even mid-routine.

enum.name: AD_REQUEST
enum.description: What the ground station is asking the vehicle to re-send.

entry.name: AD_REQ_MANIFEST
entry.description: Manifest, modes and mission command list.

entry.name: AD_REQ_PARAM_META
entry.description: Parameter metadata, for one index or all.

message.name: ARDUDECK_MANIFEST
message.description: What this vehicle is and what it supports. Sent on a slow repeat and on request. A capability not declared here is a screen the ground station will not show.
message.field: SDK contract revision this firmware was built against.
Mission items the vehicle can store. 0 when missions are unsupported.
Flight modes that follow as ARDUDECK_MODE.
Stable identity for this airframe, or empty.

message.name: ARDUDECK_MODE
message.description: One flight mode, by name. Without this the mode picker shows a number and the operator guesses.
message.field: The value this firmware reports in HEARTBEAT custom_mode.
Total modes, so a receiver knows when it has them all.
How it behaves in the picker.

message.name: ARDUDECK_MISSION_CMDS
message.description: Mission commands this firmware honours, as MAV_CMD values. A plan containing anything else is refused before the operator can send it.

message.name: ARDUDECK_PARAM_META
message.description: What a parameter means. PARAM_VALUE carries the number; this carries everything that makes it editable rather than guessable.
message.field: Step for the editor, 0 for continuous.
Index in the table, matching PARAM_VALUE.
Named options that follow, 0 for a plain number.
Unit shown beside the field. Empty for a pure gain.
One line. What changing it does, not what it is called.

message.name: ARDUDECK_PARAM_OPTION
message.description: One named choice for a parameter, so the operator picks a word instead of looking up a number.
message.field: Position in the list, from 0. This is the stored value.
Parameter name, for receivers that key on it.

message.name: ARDUDECK_CAL_DECLARE
message.description: One calibration the vehicle offers. The routine stays in the firmware; this describes it well enough for the ground station to draw the screen.
message.field: Which of the four shapes this is.
What the operator must be warned about.
Stable id. Use a standard one where it fits; anything else still renders.
Shown before Start, in the vendor's own words.

message.name: ARDUDECK_CAL_POSE
message.description: One attitude the operator has to hold. The ground station draws the live vehicle against a ghost in this pose and they converge.
message.field: Shown as the instruction, for example Nose down.

message.name: ARDUDECK_CAL_TRACK
message.description: One thing that must reach a target before a coverage calibration is done. A routine that settles two things in one motion declares two tracks.
message.field: Position in the list, from 0, maximum 3.
Unit, empty for a count or a ratio.

message.name: ARDUDECK_CAL_CONTROL
message.description: What the operator pressed on a calibration screen.

message.name: ARDUDECK_CAL_PROGRESS
message.description: Where a running calibration has got to. Sent as often as the firmware likes; the SDK throttles it.
message.field: Where each coverage track has got to.
Pose being waited for, for AD_CAL_POSITIONAL.
1 when that pose was just captured.
Overall progress, 0 to 100, or 255 for unknown.
Optional coaching, for example Turn more slowly.

message.name: ARDUDECK_CAL_RESULT
message.description: How a calibration ended. Every parameter it wrote must also be re-announced with PARAM_VALUE, or the editor shows stale offsets and the next save undoes the calibration.
message.field: Fit quality 0 to 1, or NaN when the firmware does not compute one.
What happened, in the vendor's own words.

message.name: ARDUDECK_REQUEST
message.description: Ask the vehicle to re-send something it describes about itself.
message.field: Which item, or 65535 for all of them.
